Full summary: Phase 1 status: Tasks 1-4 committed (262ce0f seed fixture, 1af2e2a /api/index, 00e8488 blackboard detail, c03ffaf graph summary/entities), all reviews approved. Task 5 (/api/graph/neighborhood) implementer subagent currently running; its in-progress edits are the uncommitted changes.
Findings: Recurring process friction confirmed (4th occurrence): the Twining stop hook blocks implementer subagents' session exit when the controller centralizes twining_record — controller-side records clear it, and pre-empting the conflict in dispatch prompts avoids the escalation round-trip. Supports the existing 'stop hook perverse incentive' memory; consider a hook allowance for subagent sessions.
